Lab group registration for Mulungushi University (ICT361 Mobile Application Development group project).
Privacy: your data is only sent to the server above, over HTTPS when hosted. Signing out clears the data saved on this phone. Passwords and codes are never stored on the phone.

Sign out, then tap "Forgot password?" on the sign-in screen. A 6-digit code is e-mailed to your recovery e-mail (lecturers: your staff e-mail). No e-mail added? Ask your lecturer for a reset code. While signed in, you can change your password above.
You can keep working: changes are saved on this phone and marked Saved locally. They are sent once you\'re back online. Lists show this phone\'s copy until then.

Saved locally: only on this phone so far. Pending / Syncing: being sent. Synced: the server has it. Action required: the server refused the change (for example the group is full, or someone else changed the record first). Open it to edit again or discard your change.
Each group holds at most 15 students. Ask for a place on the Groups tab. Saving a request doesn\'t reserve a place: the server decides, and if the group fills up first you keep your current group.

Groups hold at most 15 students (some older groups allow 16). On the Groups tab you can create a group, auto-assign unassigned students, delete a group (its students become Unassigned) and export everything to Excel.
Your profile shows your details and group. You can change your name and programme yourself; a student number change must be requested and approved by a lecturer.
From the Roster tab, tap ⋮ next to a student for claim codes, password reset codes, editing and deleting. Share codes only with that student, privately.
